label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Hiya all,

Right, I've got some news and I need you all to keep it under your hats, especially you, Linda, because Gran's no in on this yet!

Morag who owns the salon (Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd, you all know it) has said I can have the place to myself on the Saturday afternoon before Gran's 80th. She closes at 12 that day, so from 1pm it's ours. And I'm doing everyone's hair for free before we head out for her dinner.

So here's the plan. It's me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, and Kirsty's two wee ones, Ava and Ruby. That's seven heads. Cut and blow-dry is free for everyone, no arguments. Colours are a bit different because I need to order the stuff from the wholesaler, so if you want one, let me know by Friday 27th November at the latest. Don't leave it til the last minute. And Linda, I'm no doing your colour in your kitchen again. The dog still hasnae forgiven me.

Gran said at Easter she'd love to go silver properly but wouldnae pay salon prices, so this is her chance. Mum, I need you for this bit: can you get her down to the salon for 1pm without telling her why? Say you're taking her for a wee shopping trip or a coffee. She'll be suspicious, but you're the best at it.

Ava and Ruby, you can get wee braids and glitter spray. I know you'll love it.

Dinner's booked for 8.30 at the Italian place on Byres Rd, table for nine including Uncle Davie and Kirsty's man. Morag says we can bring a bottle of fizz to the salon as long as we tidy up after ourselves, so everyone's on sweeping and brush duty when we're done.

Get back to me with what you want, colours or no colours, and let me know if you can't make it. I'm buzzing about this and I want it to be a good day for everyone.

Love,
[Your name]

---

One thing to check before this goes in with the invites: if Gran is getting an envelope too, keep this letter out of it. Put it in the family group chat or hand it to your mum, Kirsty and Linda separately.
